name: Landgasthof Klause
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Landgasthof Klause in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, **Landgasthof Klause** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers breathtaking views of rolling green meadows and towering peaks.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, and tender **Schweinsbraten**—all made with fresh, local ingredients. Our warm, family-run atmosphere ensures you’ll feel right at home.

Whether you’re seeking relaxation after a day of hiking or a lively evening with traditional music and **Schnaps**, **Landgasthof Klause** promises an unforgettable stay in the mountains. Come and discover the true spirit of **Tirol**!
